depth.text: Drill hole ES-7 was collared 54 metres northeast of ES-1 and drilled towards the northwest at a 75-degree dip to a depth of 861 metres. Strong mineralization extends to a depth of 514 metre

metallurgy.summary: refractory, oxide ore present, transitional ore present, sulphide ore; processed by heap leach, then flotation to concentrate, then SX-EW, then pressure oxidation; stated recovery Cu 71%
